{{Template:Top bar|next = First Contact (expansion)|previous = First Anthology (Star Trek CCG 1E)}} {{Infobox_game |card = The Fajo Collection |image = Fajocollection_binder.jpg |imagewidth = 200px |caption = Binder |game = [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]] |expansion = The Fajo Collection |publisher = [[Decipher]] |country = USA |date = 1997 |Card Size = 63x88mm |language = English |Cards Total = 18}} '''The Fajo Collection''' is the eleventh expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 31 December 1997. The set consists of 18 promotional cards. '''The Fajo Collection''' contains 18 super-rare cards designed to enhance the value and playability of all other cards of the Star Trek CCG universe to date. Each set contains these extraordinary elements: a presentation binder, a signed Certificate of Authenticity, a 4 page Fajo Collection rules document, a collectible art poster showcasing the entire Star Trek CCG universe cards issued to date, a "Proof-of-Purchase Event" rebate coupon to be used with the special doorway "Door to the Fajo Collection" coupon included with the '''[[First Anthology]]''' box set, a Dixon Hill business card, and a wrapped bubble gum package. Also included is a $50 rebate voucher towards the purchase of uncut sheets of white border '''[[Premiere Unlimited '95]]''' cards. The set is noted for the following: * Includes the first and only instance of an Interrupt/Event card * First expansion to introduce a Neutral personnel card with the ANIMAL classification * First expansion to introduce a triple affiliation personnel card * First expansion to introduce a dual personnel card * Only expansion to include a card in Klingon, '''Qapla'!''' This first-edition printing is limited to 40,000 sets. [[Decipher]] considered this set a first run; however no serial number over 15,000 has been found.
